rule: Shared foundation is frozen at schema v0.1. Unified Search consumes shared references while each LOC retains canonical ownership; future corpus imports extend coverage without changing stable IDs.

foundation_status.note: Shared foundation is complete enough to begin corpus migration and later interface consolidation. Domain corpora may still be pending without changing the shared schema.

integration_stage.ranking_rule: Results are grouped by authority/content type; heterogeneous engine scores are not forced onto one global ranking scale.
